label.responsibilities:
Taking responsibility for building, developing and maintaining database systems, API system for projects.
Taking responsibility for checking and fixing bugs.
Learning, evaluating and applying new technologies to build new projects, as well as optimize incomplete functions.
Taking responsibility for reporting work to management (Leader, PO).
Coordinating with BA, Front-end, Designer, QC/QA department to understand project requirements, propose optimal solutions to perform requirements.
label.requirements:
Having at least 1.5 years of experience working with .NET/.NET Core, PostgreSQL, MySQL/SQL Server, Entity Framework/Swagger.
Having experience in building medium and large-scale software projects, microservices architecture.
Having experience working with database management systems (SQL/NoSQL).
Have knowledge of LINQ/LAMBDA/JSON.
Understanding the concept as well as how to build function with REST API, OOP, SOLID, DI, Repository design pattern.
Having experience in writing unit tests.
Having experience in cloud-based, cloud-service (Azure is an advantage).
Reading and understanding English documents.
